g.text: Floral-profile sharing between islands after removing shared taxa

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4a5056

g.text: Observed median Jaccard similarity and a regional, within-genus permutation reference

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4a5056

g.text: 999 profile-label permutations per completed comparison; one assignment is reused across all sampled pairs in its regime

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a5056

g.text: Horizontal bands are central 95% permutation null ranges, not effect confidence intervals. Outlined observed points: BY q ≥ 0.05.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a5056

g.text: q values use BY adjustment across the fixed 16-comparison family; BH values are retained in the results table. Missing comparisons remain in that family.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a5056

g.text: Support: both islands have ≥50 complete taxon-name records and retain ≥20 nonshared names in both scopes; at most 2,000 pairs per regime and encoding.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a5056

g.text: All and Direct share sampled pair IDs within each encoding. Encodings can use different pairs; overlapping scopes are not independent replication.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a5056

g.text: Each sampled pair has equal weight. The regional genus reference fixes profile frequencies per taxon; differences do not establish an evolutionary mechanism.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a5056

g.text: Permutation and pair-selection seed: 20261106. Both panels use the same raw Jaccard axis scale.
